digest.component_or_area: completion verifier budget and evidence caching
propositions: Verifier step budget exhausts on legitimate validation (epic/multi-AC criteria) causing false unmet verdicts within the same run; current defaults (8 steps/criterion, 48 floor) do not scale with evidence surface (child traversal, fixed overhead) despite separate runaway guards already present

Budget formula must account for evidence-surface scaling: per-criterion steps + child-traversal term (steps per direct child) + fixed overhead, with direct_children enumerated from the ticket graph at sizing time and failures failing open to 0

Re-verify cycles re-prove all criteria at ~10 min/cycle; a cross-run PASS-verdict cache keyed by (criterion-text hash, scoped content fingerprint of file_impact blobs) allows seeding validated PASS into the run bank, excluding seeded criteria from the primary work surface and protecting them from finalizer downgrade

Scoped content fingerprint must bind to the verification target ref (resolving blob SHAs at that ref, not HEAD) so verdicts proven against a specific commit's tree are cached correctly and reused only when re-verifying that same ref, preventing illegitimate cache hits across unrelated commits

Budget defaults raised to 24 steps/criterion and 160 floor with 960 clamp (vs. prior 8/48/480); budget formula with child-traversal term and fixed-overhead term sizes a 6-AC epic to ≥80 requests and 15-AC epic to ≥180; runaway guards (tool_calls_limit, loop detection) remain authoritative and unchanged

Cached PASS verdicts are persisted only after validation success, seeded into subsequent runs with seeded:true flag, excluded from primary manifest and context, and protected from finalizer echo/omission/downgrade judgment; same-run finalizer downgrades remain preserved via the seeded flag rule
